diagnosis.legacy_viewer: CodeMirror iframe editor with lineNumbers=true, textWrapping=true and continuousScanning=500, used for a source preview with no save operation.
diagnosis.observed_before: Local tests completed; some runs had main-thread tasks lasting 51-77 ms. This does not establish the cause of the reported complete browser hang.
diagnosis.change: Use the existing native textarea as a readonly source preview; disable spellchecking and wrapping, size it to its pane, and remove viewer-only editor startup and resize scripts. The formatted preview and source content remain available.
diagnosis.tradeoff: Raw preview no longer provides syntax highlighting or line numbers.

limitations: The exact original hang could not be reproduced; the change removes the unnecessary legacy editor and its background work.
Browser tests used the production document rendered locally with the application template/assets; no logged-in production browser session was used.
